purpose: Teach: 課す/形容/メンツ/熟知/表向き/細々/退会/寄附

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 新人に基本タスクを課すスケジュールを組みましょう
lines.en: Let's draw up a schedule for assigning basic tasks to the new hire.
lines.style: Crisp, professional. Opens with light confidence. Measured pace, no hesitation. The voice of someone who has thought this through already and is laying out the plan clearly.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新サービスをお客様向けに形容する文章を準備しました
lines.en: Yes. I've prepared the copy describing the new service for our clients.
lines.style: Respectful, ready-to-move-forward tone. Slight warmth beneath the formality. Delivers the status update with quiet competence, no embellishment.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: お取引先のメンツを尊重した提案にしましょう
lines.en: Let's make sure the proposal respects our business partners' standing.
lines.style: Calm but directive. Light emphasis on 「respect」. Speaking from experience. Not lecturing—guiding. The tone of someone who knows what protects the relationship long-term.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。市場を熟知した担当者を割り当てます
lines.en: Yes. I'll assign someone who knows the market well.
lines.style: Affirming and efficient. Slight nod in the voice. No wasted words. The rhythm of someone who understands the direction and is already thinking through the execution.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 表向きには無料、実際はオプション課金は避けましょう
lines.en: Let's avoid making it look free up front when it's actually optional paid features underneath.
lines.style: Steady, principled. Speaks with quiet firmness—this is a line not to cross. No blame, just clarity. The voice of someone protecting the company's integrity.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社内の細々した業務を整理しました
lines.en: Yes. I've already consolidated our internal workflow tasks.
lines.style: Brief, satisfied. Slight lift of accomplished confidence. Delivers cleanly without overstatement. The ease of someone who has already checked this box.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 会員の退会理由を集計しましょう
lines.en: Let's collect data on why members are cancelling their accounts.
lines.style: Methodical, forward-thinking. Slight pause before the direction lands. Speaking as someone who sees the value in understanding customer loss. Calm and purposeful.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社員からの寄附も募ります
lines.en: Yes. I'll also reach out to staff about potential donations.
lines.style: Warm closing note. Slight lift in tone—this is a human element. Genuine, not forced. The gentle ease of someone wrapping up and looking ahead to the next good thing.
